54: The blessing which you shall hear. Hearing is a vessel that holds blessing as it says "if he made him deaf, he pays his entire value." If so, hearing is the wholeness/completeness of humanity. And the essence is that this world does not have wholeness/completeness. And the human, who is the end-point of creation, was created only for the sake of hearing the word of Gd. And this is his wholeness, that he is a vessel prepared to honor the One of Blessed Name. And according to his preparation to hear the Creator's mitzvot, so is the wholeness. And through this one merits to receive blessing.
